title: Separate staged-index bytes from future working-copy conversion
failure_signature: The exact x1 staging pass succeeded but Git warned that twenty-one LF working-copy files may be replaced by CRLF the next time Git touches them.
trigger_preconditions: New UTF-8 text artifacts with LF working-copy bytes
Exact Git add of the x1 packet
candidate_workaround: Treat staged Git blobs as the commit and content-seal domain, verify their newline form directly, and reserve working-tree portability for the one clean named replay.
recurrence_guard: Keep index-byte and working-tree-byte claims separate; never infer cross-checkout parity from a successful stage operation.
rollback: No rollback is needed because staging succeeded; retain the warnings, stop if staged blob parity fails, and make no host line-ending configuration change.
scope_boundary: This method addresses newline portability only and proves no scientific, privacy, security, accessibility, authority, identity, or independent-reproduction claim.
